title: Rating Window by Account Tenure for Professional Host Plus Enrollment
content:
# Professional Hosting Programme — Rating Window by Account Tenure (Host Accounts)

For an enrollment of a Host Accounts holder, the listing rating covers the listing quality assessments dated within a window set by how long ago the account was opened:

| Account opened, in whole calendar months before the enrollment | Listing quality assessments covered |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | Those dated within the 9 months before the enrollment |
| At least 36 but fewer than 60 | Those dated within the 6 months before the enrollment |
| Fewer than 36 | No longer window applies |

A window of a number of months holds the records dated fewer than that many whole calendar months before the date of the enrollment. Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the date of the enrollment.

## Boundaries (hypothetical opening date 10 May 2021)

| Enrollment date | Whole calendar months since opening | Window |
|---|---|---|
| 10 May 2026 | 60 | 9 months |
| 9 May 2026 | 59 | 6 months |
| 10 May 2024 | 36 | 6 months |
| 9 May 2024 | 35 | No longer window |
